message.content: {"note_claim": "US strikes (Operation Midnight Hammer) obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan, per the White House.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Dan \"Razin\" Caine : \"Initial battle damage assessments indicate that all three sites sustained extremely severe damage and destruction.", "reason": "The White House release asserts the strikes obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities, with IAEA statements naming Natanz and Esfahan and Fordow, though it doesn't use the name 'Midnight Hammer' and the note's '2028' date is off."}

parsed.note_claim: US strikes (Operation Midnight Hammer) obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities at Natanz, Fordow, and Isfahan, per the White House.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Dan "Razin" Caine : "Initial battle damage assessments indicate that all three sites sustained extremely severe damage and destruction.
parsed.reason: The White House release asserts the strikes obliterated Iran's nuclear facilities, with IAEA statements naming Natanz and Esfahan and Fordow, though it doesn't use the name 'Midnight Hammer' and the note's '2028' date is off.
